reference_platform: MATLAB R2025a Update 1 / Simulink / Simscape / Simscape Electrical
criteria: All thirteen signals must meet both fixed limits in all three windows. Independently verify piecewise resistive KCL, weighted floating-neutral voltage, source/load power and exact right-side resistance changes. No time, amplitude or phase fitting.
known_difference: PyCy reproduces the independent grounded-neutral and floating-neutral networks only; the official third open-return network is omitted, not modeled as floating. Both retained sources are ideal, grounded at their source neutral, identical positive-sequence 100 V peak / 60 Hz sine waves. Loads are pure resistances; no dynamic integration accuracy is claimed. Official default local solver is backward Euler at 100 us; PyCy uses the same 100 us output grid and explicit resistor events. A 200 us guard on each side excludes event intervals from continuous interpolation. The official PlotResults script interchanges grounded/floating CURRENT labels: XML connects Sensing_vi to the grounded branch and Sensing_vi2 to the floating branch; this mapping, not the plot legend, defines reference currents. v_neutral is reconstructed from grounded phase-a voltage minus floating load phase-a voltage using the identical sources. Original model, raw log and original-label CSV remain local.
